explanation: The proposed path from a session starting to a warning on the approval card. Step 4 is the new part Collin sees; nothing in it can stop Start building. Leaves out the rule for what counts as growth, which is the open question.

events.label: A Claude agent session starts
events.detail: As today; the machine already notes it in its session record.

events.label: Its first turn ends
events.detail: The machine reads how many tokens that first call used, and which Claude Code version ran it, and adds one line to the record.

events.label: The lead runs its Ready check
events.detail: It also asks the machine whether any role's sessions grew.

events.label: Approval card shows the warning
events.detail: Next to the Ready result, as information only. A failed check just shows nothing.
